cases.rule: Immutable non-UTC DailySlots<15min> Range uses host civil occurrence facts and a fixed elapsed duration, with stable site/sourceDay/slotKey/fold identity.
cases.given: GFB21/control-v21 has Seoul 22:00+7h and 05:00+17h schedules with host coverage containing previous-day occurrences.
cases.when: A first trusted scan occurs at 23:00 or 04:59, or accepted scans cross midnight, 05:00 and 22:00; malformed, duplicate, conflicting or overlapping civil facts are supplied separately.
cases.then: Native Rust, WASM and ghostsim admit only the remaining half-open interval, agree on compiled outputs, preserve occurrence dedup across restored checkpoints and reject invalid facts without committing the scan.
cases.reason: The host owns IANA tzdb enumeration and declared coverage completeness; core validation cannot independently prove an initially omitted IANA occurrence.
